insights.headline: Gold steadies near $4,100 as yields ease; MCX firms ahead of the RBI decision
insights.summary: Gold steadied around $4,100-4,200 an ounce — 26% below January's $5,595 record — as soft US payrolls cut October Fed-hike bets, though December hike risk and elevated yields capped gains. YieldMax's Michael Khouw told Kitco the 10-year yield near 5.32% competes with gold, but fiat erosion keeps the long-term case intact. On MCX, bullion edged higher while the rupee slid to a two-month low near 96.42 ahead of Wednesday's RBI decision, where most economists expect a 25bp hike.
points: Gold is 26% below January's $5,595 record; Kotak, Choice and Tata MF analysts say the Diwali season offers a possible entry window.
Spot gold and silver rose as Treasury yields eased, but December Fed-hike risk remains, Kitco's AM report notes.
YieldMax's Michael Khouw: 10-year yields near 5.32% compete with gold, yet fiat-currency erosion keeps its long-term case intact.
MCX: gold near Rs.1.49 lakh/10g and silver near Rs.2.26 lakh/kg edged higher as weak US payrolls eased October Fed-hike bets.
Rupee closed at 96.42, a two-month low; about 60% of economists polled by Reuters expect a 25bp RBI hike on Wednesday.

trending.title: A 26% discount meets Diwali
trending.summary: Gold's slide from January's record lands right at peak festive buying. Titan's 21% jewellery growth and early NRI buying in Dubai suggest demand is stirring even at these prices.

trending.title: Yields vs the debasement trade
trending.summary: Yields near 5.3% are gold's toughest rival in years, yet strategists argue fiat erosion keeps the structural bid alive even as December Fed-hike risk lingers.

trending.title: The rupee is the local price-maker
trending.summary: At a two-month low of 96.42 to the dollar, the rupee cushions global dips for importers. Wednesday's RBI decision — most economists expect a 25bp hike — could steady the currency.

trending.title: Silver's supply story flips
trending.summary: Brokerages see silver swinging from deficit to surplus by 2027 even as technicians eye $64 — the white metal is caught between glut fears and momentum.

items.title: Gold corrects 26% from January record high — is this a buying opportunity ahead of Diwali?
items.summary: Gold is down more than 26% from its January record of $5,595 an ounce to around $4,100, pressured by multi-decade-high US Treasury yields and a firm dollar; analysts at Kotak Securities, Choice Broking and Tata Mutual Fund say valuations have turned more attractive and the festive/Diwali season could offer an entry window.

items.title: Gold, silver prices rise as yields ease but December Fed risk remains
items.summary: Spot gold and silver rose in early US trading as long-dated Treasury yields eased; US data was mixed — September payrolls added just 29,000 while the ISM services PMI hit its highest since July 2022 — and Fed-funds pricing now leans toward no change at the December meeting.

items.title: Rupee hits two-month low on outflows, investors await RBI outcome with hike priced in
items.summary: The rupee fell to a two-month low, closing at 96.42 to the dollar on equity outflows, as traders braced for Wednesday's RBI policy decision where about 60% of economists polled by Reuters expect a 25bp hike — a move that could steady the currency and trim local gold prices.

items.title: Gold, Silver Edge Higher On MCX As Fed Rate-Hike Bets Ease
items.summary: Bullion edged higher on MCX after softer US jobs data eased October Fed rate-hike bets; December gold futures traded around ₹1,49,212 per 10 grams and December silver near ₹2,26,322 per kg by mid-afternoon, though elevated Treasury yields capped gains ahead of the Oct 27-28 FOMC meeting.

items.title: Gold, silver edge higher on MCX: Key levels to watch
items.summary: Gold and silver traded higher on MCX on Tuesday, extending the recovery from September's correction as soft US payrolls eased October Fed-hike bets; analysts flagged key support and resistance levels to watch ahead of the Oct 27-28 FOMC meeting.

items.title: 5.3% bond yields can compete with gold, but they can't stop fiat currency erosion - YieldMax's Khouw
items.summary: YieldMax chief strategist Michael Khouw told Kitco that 10-year yields near 5.32% make cash and bonds real competition for gold, yet persistent inflation eroding fiat purchasing power keeps the metal's long-term diversification case intact.

items.title: Silver may enter surplus by 2027 from supply deficit; brokerages see prices consolidating
items.summary: Brokerages expect silver's long-running supply deficit to narrow through 2026 and the market to flip into surplus by 2027, which should keep prices consolidating rather than extending the rally; 12-month brokerage targets on MCX sit around ₹3.5–4 lakh per kg, CNBC-TV18 reports.

items.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD builds base above $60, eyes $64
items.summary: Silver is building a base above $60, up over 1% to $61.13 after bouncing off $60.36 lows, FXStreet's technical desk notes; a break above $62 opens the way toward $64–65 resistance, while a drop below the Oct 2 low of $59.69 would turn the short-term bias bearish.

items.title: Titan Q2FY27 update: Consumer businesses grow 25% YoY, jewellery up 21%
items.summary: Titan's consumer businesses grew 25% year-on-year in Q2FY27 excluding bullion, with jewellery up 21%, watches 30%, EyeCare 28% and international business 97%; the company added 78 net stores, a strong signal of jewellery demand heading into the festive season.

items.title: Dubai gold prices drop further ahead of Indian festivals Navratri, Diwali
items.summary: Dubai gold slipped further on Tuesday, with 24K at Dh496.75 a gram at the open — below Dh500 — prompting early festive buying by NRI families ahead of Navratri and Diwali; Pepperstone's Chris Weston says the short-term investment case for gold remains weak.
